### clean environment
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
```

```{r}
path <- getwd()
new_path <- gsub("MOFA_AML/.*","MOFA_AML/",path)
```

### set directory (replace by your repository)
```{r setup}
    knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(new_path)) 
```

  
```{r}
library(MultiAssayExperiment)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(MOFA2)
library(GSEABase)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(tidyverse)
```


### load MOFA object (replace by directory)
```{r}
load("data/input_files/Data_MOFA/MOFA_object/MOFA_model_v04.RData")
mofa.sel
```

```{r}
sel.path <- readxl::read_excel("data/Pathways/Reactome_signatures_MOFA.xlsx")
```


# Enrichment analysis

## Reactome RNA

Read reactome flat files (v77) for Homo sapiens.
```{r}
read_delim("~/Data/MOFA_R_Objects/Ensembl2Reactome_All_Levels.txt",
           col_names = c("ensembl.ID", "Path.ID", "URI", "Path.name", "Evidence", "Species"), delim = "\t") %>%
  filter(Species=="Homo sapiens") -> ensembl.react
# ensembl.react <- read.table("~/Projects/DHR/ext_data/Ensembl2Reactome_All_Levels.txt", header = F, sep="\t", comment.char ="", quote = "")
# colnames(ensembl.react) <- c("ensembl.ID", "Path.ID", "URI", "Path.name", "Evidence", "Species")
# ensembl.react <- ensembl.react[ensembl.react$Species=="Homo sapiens",]
```

Create a binary membership matrix (rows are feature sets and columns are features).
```{r}
ensembl.react.m <- as.matrix(table(ensembl.react$Path.name, ensembl.react$ensembl.ID))
attributes(ensembl.react.m)$class <- "matrix" 
ensembl.react.m[ensembl.react.m>0] <- 1
ensembl.react.m <- ensembl.react.m[rowSums(ensembl.react.m)!=0,]
ensembl.react.m <- ensembl.react.m[,colSums(ensembl.react.m)!=0]
```

The columns matching the feature.ID will have their name changed to match the features in MOFA.
```{r}
tmp1 <- colnames(ensembl.react.m)
tmp2 <- features_metadata(mofa.sel)
tmp2 <- tmp2[grepl("^.*\\.g$", tmp2$feature),]
tmp2$id <- gsub(".g", "", tmp2$feature)
tmp1 <- as.character(tmp2$feature)[match(tmp1, tmp2$id)]
tmp1[is.na(tmp1)] <- colnames(ensembl.react.m)[is.na(tmp1)]
colnames(ensembl.react.m) <- tmp1
```

### Positive sign

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=20}
res.r.pos <- run_enrichment(mofa.sel, view = "RNAseq", feature.sets = ensembl.react.m, sign = "positive")
p.r.pos <- res.r.pos$pval.adj
p.r.pos <- p.r.pos[, colMeans(is.na(p.r.pos)) < 1]
p.r.pos <- -log10(p.r.pos)
col <- colorRampPalette(c("lightgrey", "red"))(n = 100)
pheatmap::pheatmap(p.r.pos[!rowSums(p.r.pos>6, na.rm = T) == ncol(p.r.pos),, drop=FALSE],
                   color = col, show_rownames = T, cluster_cols = F,  labels_row = str_trunc(rownames(p.r.pos), width = 40))
```
### Negative sign

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=20}
res.r.neg <- run_enrichment(mofa.sel, view = "RNAseq", feature.sets = ensembl.react.m, sign = "negative")
p.r.neg <- res.r.neg$pval.adj
p.r.neg <- p.r.neg[, colMeans(is.na(p.r.neg)) < 1]
p.r.neg <- -log10(p.r.neg)
col <- colorRampPalette(c("lightgrey", "red"))(n = 100)
pheatmap::pheatmap(p.r.neg[!rowSums(p.r.neg>6, na.rm = T) == ncol(p.r.neg),, drop=FALSE],
                   color = col, show_rownames = T, cluster_cols=F, labels_row = str_trunc(rownames(p.r.neg), width = 40))
```


### Reactome Protein

Create a binary membership matrix (rows are feature sets and columns are features).
```{r}
ensembl.react.m <- as.matrix(table(ensembl.react$Path.name, ensembl.react$ensembl.ID))
attributes(ensembl.react.m)$class <- "matrix" 
ensembl.react.m[ensembl.react.m>0] <- 1
ensembl.react.m <- ensembl.react.m[rowSums(ensembl.react.m)!=0,]
ensembl.react.m <- ensembl.react.m[,colSums(ensembl.react.m)!=0]
```

The columns matching the feature.ID will have their name changed to match the features in MOFA.
```{r}
tmp1 <- colnames(ensembl.react.m)
tmp2 <- features_metadata(mofa.sel)
tmp2 <- tmp2[grepl("^.*\\.p$", tmp2$feature),]
tmp2$id <- gsub(".p", "", tmp2$feature)
tmp1 <- as.character(tmp2$feature)[match(tmp1, tmp2$id)]
tmp1[is.na(tmp1)] <- colnames(ensembl.react.m)[is.na(tmp1)]
colnames(ensembl.react.m) <- tmp1
```

#### Positive sign

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=20}
res.p.pos <- run_enrichment(mofa.sel, view = "Proteomics", feature.sets = ensembl.react.m, sign = "positive")
p.p.pos <- res.p.pos$pval.adj
p.p.pos <- p.p.pos[, colMeans(is.na(p.p.pos)) < 1]
p.p.pos <- -log10(p.p.pos)
col <- colorRampPalette(c("lightgrey", "red"))(n = 100)
pheatmap::pheatmap(p.p.pos[!rowSums(p.p.pos>6, na.rm = T) == ncol(p.p.pos),, drop=FALSE],
                   color = col, show_rownames = T, cluster_cols = F, labels_row = str_trunc(rownames(p.p.pos), width = 40))
```


#### Negative sign

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=20}
res.p.neg <- run_enrichment(mofa.sel, view = "Proteomics", feature.sets = ensembl.react.m, sign = "negative")
p.p.neg <- res.p.neg$pval.adj
p.p.neg <- p.p.neg[, colMeans(is.na(p.p.neg)) < 1]

```

Only top pathways (FDR<10^-25)

```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=6}
hm1 <- Heatmap(t(p.r.pos),
               name="-log10(FDR)",
               column_title = "Transcripts positive weights",
               column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize=16, fontface = "bold"),
               show_row_names = T, show_column_names = F,
               cluster_columns = T, cluster_rows = F,
               clustering_distance_columns = "pearson",
               row_names_side = "left",
               column_names_side = "bottom",
               bottom_annotation = columnAnnotation(
                 pathways=anno_mark(
                   at = which(rowSums(p.r.pos>=25)>=1),
                   labels = str_trunc(names(which(rowSums(p.r.pos>=25)>=1)),40),
                   side="bottom"
                 )
               ),
               col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(1, 40), c("gray95", "red"), space = "RGB"))

hm2 <- Heatmap(t(p.r.neg),
               name="-log10(FDR)",
               column_title = "Transcripts negative weights",
               column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize=16, fontface = "bold"),
               show_row_names = F, show_column_names = F,
               cluster_columns = T, cluster_rows = F,
                clustering_distance_columns = "pearson",
               column_names_side = "bottom",
               bottom_annotation = columnAnnotation(
                 pathways=anno_mark(
                   at = which(rowSums(p.r.neg>=25)>=1),
                   labels = str_trunc(names(which(rowSums(p.r.neg>=25)>=1)),40),
                   side="bottom"
                 )
               ),
               col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(1, 40), c("gray95", "red"), space = "RGB"))

hm3 <- Heatmap(t(p.p.pos),
               name="-log10(FDR)",
               column_title = "Proteins positive weights",
               column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize=16, fontface = "bold"),
               show_row_names = F, show_column_names = F,
               cluster_columns = T, cluster_rows = F,
               clustering_distance_columns = "pearson",
               column_names_side = "bottom",
               bottom_annotation = columnAnnotation(
                 pathways=anno_mark(
                   at = which(rowSums(p.p.pos>=25)>=1),
                   labels = str_trunc(names(which(rowSums(p.p.pos>=25)>=1)), 40),
                   side="bottom"
                 )
               ),
               col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(1, 40), c("gray95", "red"), space = "RGB"))


hm4 <- Heatmap(t(p.p.neg),
               name="-log10(FDR)",
               column_title = "Proteins negative weights",
               column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize=16, fontface = "bold"),
               show_row_names = F, show_column_names = F,
               cluster_columns = T, cluster_rows = F,
               clustering_distance_columns = "pearson",
               column_names_side = "bottom",
               bottom_annotation = columnAnnotation(
                 pathways=anno_mark(
                   at = which(rowSums(p.p.neg>=25)>=1),

                   side="bottom"
                 )
               ),
               col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(1, 40), c("gray95", "red"), space = "RGB"))
```
